newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Thieves use confiscated tools in Belgian burglary.
newsitem.headline: Thieves use confiscated tools in Belgian burglary.

text.p: Thieves broke into the justice palace in the city of Ghent and used burglary tools that had been confiscated by police to break open a vault where seized arms were kept, Belgian radio said on Monday.

The thieves escaped with a substantial amount of money as well as guns and ammunition seized by police in various raids. Belga news agency said the thieves did not touch any of confiscated drugs that were also stored in the justice palace.
